title: obione peruviana
intro: Obione peruviana, commonly known as Peruvian fleabane, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to South America, particularly in Peru. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, thanks to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Obione peruviana include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal activities, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
